rules.name: TERRITORIAL AGGRESSION
rules.text: Your Damage-Dealing Powers do +1 Damage. (This adds +1 Damage total for the Power, even if the Power Damages multiple Invaders or "each Invader". It can boost Minor/Major Power Cards, too, not just your Uniques + Innate.)
rules.turn:
power-strike S P L, spirit:special S territorial-aggression, power:damage P N, gt N 0
  / power-damage S P L 1
rules.evidence: power-damage teeth gnaw l3 2 (printed 1); 'assign-damage l3 2; count l3 town 0; fear 1'. Control: 'assign-damage l3 1; count l3 town 1; fear 0'.
rules.notes: Exactly the 'reify every modifiable quantity as a @sum' pattern: once the base sums a Power's Damage per use, '+1 Damage total for the Power, even if it damages multiple Invaders' is one contribution, and 'Damage-Dealing Powers' is the guard power:damage P N, gt N 0. Uses bx-damage.t.

base_ext: bx-damage.t (see heat). Run: run.sh core.t bx-damage.t spirit-teeth.t
